args.title: Fix error toast accessibility and dismissal behavior
args.body:
File: src/components/Toast.tsx

Change the aria-live region for error toasts from polite to assertive, and remove the automatic dismissal after 5 seconds. Error messages should be announced immediately and stay visible until the user dismisses them.

label: bug
file: src/components/Toast.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The error toast uses an aria-live region set to polite and automatically dismisses after 5 seconds. This is incorrect because error messages should be announced immediately and remain visible until the user dismisses them to ensure accessibility and proper user notification.
